summary: The article reports that former employees from competing aquaculture feed companies Skretting and BioMar hold central positions at a Marine Harvest production facility. The piece highlights the movement of talent between major players in the Norwegian salmon farming supply chain. The news was published in May 2017 and appears to focus on staffing changes at Marine Harvest's operations rather than on BioMar's own business directly. However, it confirms industry staff mobility and the profile of BioMar employees in the sector.
title: Eks-ansatte fra Skretting og BioMar sentrale på Marine Harvest-fabrikk
